integrity: Proof of continuous-time decay and non-Zeno flow is analytic. Exact-rational checks certify the witness identities and source hypotheses; finite arithmetic is not claimed to prove an infinite-time statement by enumeration. This work has not received independent audit.
limitations: The global predator-extinction result requires zero predator restocking, a strict uniform feeding deficit, and trajectories inside the weighted harvesting triangle. It does not deny predator-free periodic cycles or classify parameters outside the deficit region. The cited theorem literally speaks of an order-one periodic solution, which could be semitrivial; the exact witness only rules out a strictly positive one.
title: A harvesting-feasibility barrier to predator persistence in an Allee impulsive fishery
